title: Persona, Goals, Knowledge, Belief & Actor-Context Authoring
objective: Add NPC/creature persona, goals, knowledge, belief and actor-context proposal authoring over the stable MNCS candidate, identity/origin and fast-generation layers without taking relationship, reputation, world-state or owner-domain authority.

scope.purpose: Provide bounded persona, motivation/goal, knowledge/belief and actor-context proposal authoring plus life-context projections while preserving owner-domain truth and the completed MNCS-01/04/05 contracts.
scope.completion_gate: A creator can author persona, goals, knowledge, beliefs and actor context as explicit proposals/projections without silently changing canonical entity, world, relationship, reputation or owner-domain truth.

selection_boundaries: MNCS-06 completed persona, goals, knowledge, belief and actor-context proposal authoring plus life-context projections over the completed MNCS-01/04/05 substrate.
Knowledge, belief, suspicion and unresolved actor knowledge remain epistemically distinct from objective world truth; MNCS-06 cannot inject objective-truth references into actor-state proposals.
MIB-09 retains relationship and reputation authority; MNCS-06 consumes those records as reference-only actor context and cannot mutate them.
Life-context projections remain projections and do not create a second biography, relationship, reputation, world-state or canonical-event ledger.
